# EditController

> Enables inline text editing on the host element, dispatching `ui-edit-start` and `ui-edit-end`.

## Constructor

```ts
new EditController(host: HTMLElement, options?: EditOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `trigger` | `'click' | 'dblclick'` | no |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no |  |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Readonly |
|----------|------|----------|
| `isEditing` | `boolean` | yes |
| `originalValue` | `string` | yes |
| `currentValue` | `string` | yes |

## Events Dispatched

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `ui-edit-start` | `{ value }` |
| `ui-edit-commit` | `{ value, previousValue }` |
| `ui-edit-cancel` | `{ value }` |

## Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns |
|--------|------------|---------|
| `attach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `detach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `destroy()` | `—` | `void` |
| `startEdit()` | `—` | `void` |
| `commitEdit()` | `—` | `string` |
| `cancelEdit()` | `—` | `void` |

## Usage

```ts
import { EditController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new EditController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
